source: GitHub search API, queried 2026-10-11. Stars, licence and last push are refreshed by the Refresh button. Summaries restate each project's own description.

items.summary: Bootstraps AI agent companies from modular templates, as a Paperclip plugin.
items.why: Template ideas for departments this stack does not ship yet.

items.summary: 100+ specialized Claude Code subagents covering many development use cases.
items.why: A catalog of role definitions to borrow from when you add an agent.

items.summary: A hand-picked collection of resources for Claude Code.
items.why: The widest map of what people build on Claude Code.

items.summary: 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, usable from Claude Code.
items.why: Search it before writing a skill yourself.

items.summary: One hub for Claude skills, agents, commands, hooks, plugins and marketplace collections.
items.why: A single place to browse extensions before you vet one.

items.summary: A statusline dashboard for Claude Code: session info, quota bars, an agent tracker and MCP health.
items.why: Pairs with the Mod Bar if you want quota bars in the status line.

items.summary: A marketing suite for Claude Code: 15 skills that run parallel subagents, such as website audits.
items.why: Ideas for what a Brand Lead agent can audit and produce.

items.summary: 160+ open-source agent skills for SEO, social, influencer work and more.
items.why: Pick single skills for the Orrisian-style content agent instead of installing everything.

items.summary: An AI-native video production toolkit for Claude Code.
items.why: A comparison point for the Video Generator's Remotion workflow.

items.summary: A video skill for Claude Code and Codex that makes product videos with Remotion, using shot recipe cards.
items.why: Ready-made shot patterns for motion graphics.

items.summary: An open-source agentic video production system with 12 production pipelines.
items.why: Very popular, but AGPL-3.0: read the licence before using it in client work.

items.summary: Agent skills for resume optimization, job applications and career development.
items.why: Useful for polishing your Upwork profile and proposal proof points.

items.summary: An unofficial Upwork MCP server that searches jobs, analyzes them and submits proposals.
items.why: Shown so you know it exists. This stack uses Upwork's official MCP and never submits for you.
items.caution: Unofficial; submits proposals automatically, which Upwork's rules forbid

items.summary: 280+ free n8n automation templates for Gmail, Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, Google Sheets and more.
items.why: Starting points for the kind of workflows kept under Qualifi.

items.summary: An open-source template that sets up a local, self-hosted AI environment around n8n.
items.why: A way to run automations and local models without a cloud account.
